name: Machine Learning
topics: ML Basics, ML Cycle and Supervised vs Unsupervised
Explain the machine learning cycle with an example; compare supervised and unsupervised learning.
What are data objects and attribute types and their similarity measures?
Data Pre-processing, EDA and Feature Engineering
Discuss data exploration and pre-processing: data cleaning, integration, handling missing values and outliers, and feature extraction.
Explain one-hot vs label encoding, standardization, and how feature engineering improves model performance.
Validation: Train-Test Split and K-Fold Cross-Validation
Explain k-fold cross-validation; for the given dataset size, find the training and test samples per fold for 5-fold and stratified k-fold CV.
Why use a separate validation set instead of only a train–test split? What is a learning curve?
Evaluation Metrics: Confusion Matrix, ROC and AUC
For the given confusion matrix, calculate accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and F1 score.
Plot the ROC curve for the given probabilities at the given thresholds and find the AUC; which metric is appropriate for a medical screening classifier?
Linear Regression and Regularization (Ridge, LASSO)
Fit a least-squares regression line to the given points and calculate R².
Compare Ridge and LASSO regression; explain regularization and the bias–variance trade-off.
Logistic Regression
Explain logistic regression and how it is used for binary classification; how does the cut-off change along the ROC curve?
Naive Bayes Classifier
Using the given COVID-19 symptom dataset, build a naive Bayes model and compute the required probabilities.
Explain the naive Bayes classifier, class-conditional independence and its use in text classification.
k-Nearest Neighbours
Classify the new point using KNN with k = 3 and Euclidean distance for the given dataset.
Why is KNN called a lazy learner? Discuss the choice of k and distance metric.
Decision Trees (ID3, CART, Gini)
Using the Gini index (or information gain), choose the root node and build a decision tree for the given dataset.
Explain decision tree learning with its advantages and limitations.
Support Vector Machines and Kernels
Explain the working of SVM, the maximum-margin hyperplane and the significance of the margin.
Explain the kernel trick and how kernels allow SVM to handle non-linear data; differentiate hard and soft margin.
Clustering: k-Means, Hierarchical and EM
Cluster the given points into k clusters using k-means with the given initial centroids, showing each iteration.
Cluster the given points using agglomerative clustering and draw the dendrogram; explain the EM algorithm.
Dimensionality Reduction: PCA and LDA
Transform the given data into the new coordinate system using PCA.
Project the given two-class data using linear discriminant analysis; what are the motivations and drawbacks of dimensionality reduction?
Ensemble Learning: Bagging, Boosting, Random Forest
Contrast bagging and boosting; explain how Random Forest improves accuracy over a single decision tree.
Explain AdaBoost; given weak learners with weights and predictions, find the final prediction; differentiate hard and soft voting.
Hypothesis Testing for Comparing Models
Discuss statistical hypothesis testing and its use in comparing machine learning models.
